verdict.rationale: The Web Search docs explicitly let you customize results by country using 2-character country codes, which delivers the core of the localization story. The local/place search endpoints show location-aware capability, though not as a localization parameter on general results. Missing for 10: documented language/UI-language parameters, explicit location/geo parameters (e.g., lat/long or city headers) for result localization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
